question: Which company was launched later, Fresenius Kabi (United States) or Plaza & Janés?
gold_cypher: MATCH (n:Company {name: 'Fresenius Kabi (United States)'}), (m0:Company {name: 'Plaza & Janés'}) RETURN CASE WHEN n.launch_year > m0.launch_year THEN n.name ELSE m0.name END AS answer
generated_cypher:
MATCH (c1:Company),(c2:Company)
WHERE c1.name CONTAINS 'Fresenius Kabi' 
  AND c2.name CONTAINS 'Plaza & Janés' 
  AND c1.launch_year IS NOT NULL 
  AND c2.launch_year IS NOT NULL
WITH c1.name AS name1, toInteger(c1.launch_year) AS year1,
     c2.name AS name2, toInteger(c2.launch_year) AS year2
RETURN name1 AS Company1,
       year1 AS Year1,
       name2 AS Company2,
       year2 AS Year2,
       CASE
          WHEN year1 > year2 THEN name1
          WHEN year2 > year1 THEN name2
          ELSE 'Both launched the same year'
       END AS LaterCompany;
answer: Fresenius Kabi (United States) was launched later (1999) than Plaza & Janés (1959).
